answer: Output fingerprint clustering: each epoch the chain slips hidden canary prompts into every agent's workload, each tinted with a unique pigment of random constraints. Replies are compared pairwise; identities that share the same hollow phrasing, errors and timing are merged into one cluster that splits a single reward. A farmer running 300 copies of one agent earns like one, unless he pays to run 300 truly distinct models and prompts, turning each fake into a costly relic of real work.
